an8.86:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosambīsu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena icchānaṅgalaṃ nāma kosalānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari
an8.86:1.2: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.
an8.86:1.4: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito icchānaṅgalaṃ anuppatto icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe
an8.86:1.5: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃkalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato
an8.86:1.7: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotīti
an8.86:2.1: athakho icchānaṅgalakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā tassā rattiyā accayena pahūtaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ ādāya yena icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā bahidvārakoṭṭhake aṭṭhaṃsu uccāsaddā mahāsaddā.
an8.86:2.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā nāgito bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti.
an8.86:2.4: ke pana te nāgita uccāsaddā mahāsaddā kevaṭṭā maññe macchaṃ vilopentīti.
an8.86:2.5: ete bhante icchānaṅgalakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā pahūtaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ ādāya bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitā bhagavantañceva uddissa bhikkhusaṅghañcāti.
an8.86:2.6: mā tvaṃ nāgita yasena samāgama mā ca mayā yaso
an8.86:2.7: yo kho nāgita na yimassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assaṃ akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an8.86:2.8: so taṃ miḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyyāti.
an8.86:3.1: adhivāsetu dāni bhante bhagavā adhivāsetu sugato
an8.86:3.3: yena yenapi dāni bhante bhagavā gamissati tanninnā ca bhavissanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā ceva jānapadā ca
an8.86:3.4: seyyathāpi bhante thullaphusitake deve vassante yathāninnaṃ udakāni saṃvattanti
an8.86:3.5: evameva kho bhante yena yenapi dāni bhagavā gamissati tanninnā ca bhavissanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā ceva jānapadā ca
an8.86:4.1: mā tvaṃ nāgita yasena samāgama mā ca mayā yaso
an8.86:4.2: yo kho nāgita na yimassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assaṃ akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an8.86:4.3: so taṃ miḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyya.
an8.86:5.1: devatāpi kho nāgita ekaccā nayimassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhiniyo assu akicchalābhiniyo akasiralābhiniyo yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assaṃ akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an8.86:5.2: tumhākampi kho nāgita saṃgammatha samāgamma saṅgaṇikavihāraṃ anuyuttānaṃ viharataṃ evaṃ hoti
an8.86:5.3: naha nūname āyasmanto imassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhino assu akicchalābhino akasiralābhino yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assaṃ akicchalābhī akasiralābhī
an8.86:5.4: tathā hi paname āyasmanto saṃgamma samāgamma saṅgaṇikavihāraṃ anuyuttā viharanti.
an8.86:6.1: idhāhaṃ nāgita bhikkhū passāmi aññamaññaṃ aṅgulipaṭodakena sañjagghante saṃkīḷante
an8.86:6.3: naha nūname āyasmanto imassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhino assu akicchalābhino akasiralābhino yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assaṃ akicchalābhino akasiralābhino
an8.86:6.4: tathā hi paname āyasmanto aññamaññaṃ aṅgulipaṭodakena sañjagghanti saṃkīḷanti.
an8.86:7.1: idha panāhaṃ nāgita bhikkhū passāmi yāvadatthaṃ udarāvadehakaṃ bhuñjitvā seyyasukhaṃ passasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyutte viharante
an8.86:7.3: naha nūname āyasmanto imassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhino assu akicchalābhino akasiralābhino yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assaṃ akicchalābhino akasiralābhino
an8.86:7.4: tathā hi paname āyasmanto yāvadatthaṃ udarāvadehakaṃ bhuñjitvā seyyasukhaṃ passasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyuttā viharanti.
an8.86:8.1: idhāhaṃ nāgita bhikkhuṃ passāmi gāmantavihāre samāhitaṃ nisinnaṃ
an8.86:8.3: idāni imaṃ āyasmantaṃ ārāmiko vā upaṭṭhahissati samaṇuddeso vā taṃ tamhā samādhimhā gamissatīti
an8.86:8.4: tenāhaṃ nāgita tassa bhikkhuno na attamano homi gāmantavihārena
an8.86:9.1: idha panāhaṃ nāgita bhikkhuṃ passāmi araññe ca palāyamānaṃ nisinnaṃ
an8.86:9.3: idāni ayamāyasmā imaṃ niddākilamathaṃ paṭivinodetvā araññasaññaṃyeva manasi karissati ettakanti
an8.86:9.4: tenāhaṃ nāgita tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena
an8.86:10.1: idha panāhaṃ nāgita bhikkhuṃ passāmi araññe asamāhitaṃ nisinnaṃ
an8.86:10.3: idāni ayamāyasmā asamāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ samādahissati samāhitaṃ vā cittaṃ anurakkhissatīti
an8.86:10.4: tenāhaṃ nāgita tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena
an8.86:11.1: idha panāhaṃ nāgita bhikkhuṃ passāmi āraññakaṃ samāhitaṃ nisinnaṃ
an8.86:11.3: idāni ayamāyasmā avimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ vimuñcissati vimuttaṃ vā cittaṃ anurakkhissatīti
an8.86:13.3: tenāhaṃ nāgita tassa bhikkhuno attamano homi araññavihārena
an8.86:14.1: yasmāhaṃ nāgita samaye addhānamaggapaṭipanno na kiñci passāmi purato vā pacchato vā phāsu me nāgita tasmiṃ samaye hoti antamaso uccārapassāvakammassāti. 104
